description: gleam_rules.ml detect_result_in_map (~line 483): find_result_maps matches EApp(_, [fn_arg]) where fn_arg is an EFn whose body returns Result, but never checks that expr_name fn is list.map (or any map-like). Any single-arg callback-taking call (e.g. each(handler, fn(x){...})) whose lambda body happens to hit the returns_result heuristic gets reported as 'list.map with Result-returning lambda — consider list.try_map'. Also genuine list.map(list, fn) two-arg shapes fall through the [fn_arg] single-element match entirely. Fix: gate on the callee name (list.map / map) and accept both arg shapes; verify against mapper output (curried vs tupled).
title: detect_result_in_map: callee name never checked, mislabels calls
